description: This Java source file defines the ContextHelper class which provides convenience methods for working with ScriptContext objects in scripting engines. It offers methods to access environment variables, request/response objects, security context, and other contextual data relevant to scripting in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ContextHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing convenient access and manipulation methods for ScriptContext objects within OFBiz scripting environments.

methods.name: addBinding
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the script context bindings.

methods.name: expandString
methods.description: Expands environment variables embedded within strings using ${} notation.

methods.name: getBindings
methods.description: Retrieves the current bindings map from the ScriptContext.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator object from the scripting context.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the LocalDispatcher object from the scripting context.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable value using FlexibleMapAccessor.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable value by key, supporting syntax expansion.

methods.name: getEnvEntryIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the environment entries.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the Locale object associated with the scripting context.

methods.name: getVisualTheme
methods.description: Returns the VisualTheme object associated with the scripting context.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value by key from the request parameters map.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the map of parameters associated with the scripting context, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP servlet request object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the HTTP servlet response object.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves a result object by key from the script context.

methods.name: getResults
methods.description: Returns the map of results associated with the scripting context, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getScriptName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the current script, or 'Unknown' if not available.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Returns the Security object associated with the scripting context.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Returns the TimeZone object associated with the scripting context.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Returns the generic value representing the logged-in user.

methods.name: isEvent
methods.description: Checks if the script context type is EVENT.

methods.name: isService
methods.description: Checks if the script context type is SERVICE.

methods.name: putAllEnv
methods.description: Puts multiple entries into the environment map.

methods.name: putEnv
methods.description: Sets a value in the environment map using flexible key syntax.

methods.name: putParameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter key-value pair to the parameters map.

methods.name: putResult
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the script results map.

methods.name: putResults
methods.description: Inserts multiple key-value pairs into the results map.

methods.name: removeBinding
methods.description: Removes a binding from the script context by key.

methods.name: removeEnv
methods.description: Removes an environment variable entry using flexible key syntax.

methods.name: setUserLogin
methods.description: Sets the user login object into the environment with the specified key.
